title: mzPeak metadata.sample_list
description: Governs mzpeak_index.json.metadata.sample_list. This is the REUSED v0.6 sample_list shape (id/name/parameters) confirmed/authored for v0.8 sample-metadata ingestion — NO new construct (RATIFIED-E). Isobaric channels are labeled sample_list entries via MS:1002602 "sample label" + its reagent children (TMT126...); there is NO channel_list schema. Each parameters array item is an inlined CV-param object (schema/param.json does not exist in this repo — inline mirrors schema/scan_settings.json and metadata.rs). Three-places rule: this file + src/schema/study.rs (sample_list schema-agreement test) + docs/mzpeak-imaging-spec-suggestions.md (Plan 30-04 spec write-up).

items.description: A single sample entry. Analogous to the mzML sample element. For isobaric-channel studies each channel is also a sample entry carrying a 'sample label' cvParam (MS:1002602) plus reporter-m/z and role attributes.

id.description: A unique identifier for this sample within the sample_list, e.g. "s1". Corresponds to the SDRF 'source name' column after normalization.

name.description: A human-readable name for this sample. Typically the SDRF 'source name' or ISA source name verbatim.

parameters.description: CV params describing this sample (characteristics, labels, roles, etc.). Each item is an inlined CV-param object. schema/param.json does not exist in this repo; the shape is inlined here to match how scan_settings.json and metadata.rs encode cvParams.

cv_ref.description: CV code, e.g. MS, NCBITaxon, UNIMOD, CHMO

accession.description: CV accession CURIE, e.g. MS:1002602 (sample label), NCBITaxon:9606 (Homo sapiens)

value.description: Term value; absent for presence-only terms. For sample label this is the reagent name, e.g. "TMT126".

unit_accession.description: Unit accession, e.g. UO:0000221 (dalton) for reporter-ion m/z
